text:
Marc: Heads-up — saw a regression on multi-GPU pipeline runs after yesterday's kernel selector change. latency p50 jumped ~30% for long sequences. nvprof/Nsight timeline looks like lots of small all-reduces and idle gaps.
Alice: ugh. which test? is this with kv-prefetch enabled?
Marc: Repro on nightly perf job: model=redwood-7b, tp=2 pp=1, batch=4 microbatches=8, seq=2048. kv-prefetch=on. fallback kernel path picked a non-fused matmul for attention on GPU1.
Priya: can you drop the capture? want to see comm/compute overlap.
Marc: uploaded nvprof and nsight captures to the run: https://internal.artifacts/runs/1789/trace.nvvp (nvvp) and nvprof summary. key bits: long periods labeled "cudaMemcpyAsync" + NCCL allReduce kernel launches with small payloads.
Ben: small allreduces kill perf. is tensor-parallel split introducing extra small reductions per layer?
Dinesh: also check KV cache merge path — we recently changed the KVCACHE flush to be synchronous after layer boundary. that could serialize compute + comm.
Alice: good call. profiler-bot, can you emit per-layer custom-timers for next run? need compute vs comm breakdown by op kind.
profiler-bot: scheduled: will inject microsecond timers around: attention_kv_fetch(), kv_merge(), allreduce(), fused_gemm(); results posted as csv to the same run when done.
Marc: quick log snippet from nvprof summary:
```
== API calls ==
CUDA memcpy HtoD: 12 calls 4.5ms total
cudaLaunchKernel (ncclAllReduceRing): 128 calls 18.3ms total
attention_fused_gemm_kernel: 64 calls 9.2ms total
```
This suggests many small NCCL calls.
Priya: what's the per-token batch shaping? when batch splits to microbatches we might be sending <16KB per allreduce which is inefficient.
Ben: batching heuristics probably defaulting to microbatch size = seq/8. We need a policy that merges microbatches for allreduce across layers when safe.
Dinesh: Another angle: kernel selector fallback — why did it pick non-fused matmul? maybe quantization path mismatch or shared workspace too small. check selector logs.
Marc: selector log excerpt: "no fused_attention kernel for seq_len=2048 on GPU1 due to workspace bytes < 2MB -> fallback to cuBLAS_gemm"
Alice: if workspace is the issue, we can tune allocator for fused kernels in dedicated runs. but that increases peak mem. tradeoff.
Priya: For immediate mitigation, can we try: (1) disable kv-prefetch to see effect, (2) force fused kernels via env override, (3) run NCCL debug to confirm message sizes.
Ben: commands I'm using locally:
```
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0 nvprof --profile-child-processes --print-gpu-trace --time-unit us -o nvprof.%p ./bin/serve --model redwood-7b --tp 2 --pp 1 --batch 4 --microbatches 8
```
Then open nvvp to inspect timeline.
Marc: Ran variant with kv-prefetch=off: p50 dropped back ~12% (closer to baseline) — so KV prefetch + serialized merge is a big factor. But still saw many small allreduces.
Priya: sounds like two issues: kv merge serialized compute, and microbatch-induced small NCCL messages. I'd add a microbatch coalescing pass that groups tokens for NCCL when comm size under threshold.
Dinesh: Agree. Also add a selector heuristic: prefer fused kernel even if workspace slightly higher if it reduces allreduces (fewer launches). maybe quantify with the optimizer cost model.
Alice: for perf tests, let's add custom-timer outputs into perf harness CSV (fields: layer, op, compute_us, comm_us, wait_us). profiler-bot please enable for next 3 nightly runs.
profiler-bot: enabled. will run on next 3 artifacts and attach CSVs.
Marc: I'll open a small PR for: a) KV merge async option, b) microbatch coalescing threshold config, c) selector flag to override workspace constraint for fused kernels. Keep changes behind opts.
Ben: Thanks — can you add a short reproducer script and exact cmdline so infra can run it on Dedicated to validate?
Marc: yes, will paste in PR. repro command:
```
./tools/repro_run.sh --model redwood-7b --tp 2 --pp 1 --bs 4 --micro 8 --seq 2048 --kv-prefetch on
```
Also logging: set REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR_LOG=1 to capture decision reasons.
Priya: one more note — check NCCL tuning (COLLECTIVE_ALGO env overrides). sometimes ring vs tree changes latency for tiny messages. test collTune as well.
Dinesh: I'll take NCCL side experiments. Ben, can you own selector changes? Marc will do KV/merge. Alice will update perf harness.
Ben: taking selector. PR incoming in ~4h.
Marc: thanks all. hope to get baseline back by EOD. :thumbsup:
